title: NIST WebBook: Ethyl ether is C4H10O, molecular weight 74.1216 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Ethyl ether as C4H10O, molecular weight 74.1216 amu, CAS 60-29-7.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Ethyl ether, CAS Registry Number 60-29-7, lists molecular formula C4H10O and molecular weight 74.1216 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 74.0731649 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C4H10O/c1-3-5-4-2/h3-4H2,1-2H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
